'''Felix Habel''' was a former executive of [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] who was wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Habel joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and was one of the leaders of the [[Rebel cell (Lan Barell)|Rebel cell]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. Operating out of [[the Grill]] with the acknowledgment of the [[Human-Qieg Guild]] that ruled the planet, the cell had agreed to stock no heavy weapons anywhere within the [[Lan system]]. However, some firebrand members of the cell secretly established a [[Rebel weapons depot|weapons depot]] in the [[Lowlands (Lan Barell)|Lowlands]] against the nature of the agreement. When a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] at the base was destroyed by members of the radical [[Qiemal]], Habel had to send in a team to cover the incident and rescue survivors. During the Galactic Civil War, a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were close to acquiring Habel.<ref name="LB" />
